title: Assurance A: the deterministic simulations kill these on their own
note: Negative controls for tests/test_simulation_gateway.py and tests/test_simulation_research.py. The suites here are the simulations ALONE, so a kill shows that interleaving, crashing and comparing with an independent model finds the defect without the unit tests that name it. SM5 is the defect the gateway simulation found (D-2026-165).

mutations.name: SM1_the_budget_checks_only_what_is_held
mutations.rationale: the call that crosses the budget would be granted, so the budget is a floor on overspending rather than a ceiling

mutations.name: SM2_a_second_process_opens_a_second_attempt
mutations.find:
if open_ is not None:
                raise AttemptOutstanding(
mutations.rationale: two processes asking one question would both pay for it

mutations.name: SM3_a_failed_dispatch_costs_nothing
mutations.rationale: a timeout the provider may have billed would be booked as free

mutations.name: SM4_recovery_settles_inside_the_lease
mutations.find: if outcome in RECOVERY_OUTCOMES and ev.wall_time <= att.lease_until:
mutations.rationale: an attempt could be settled LOST or NOT_SENT while its call may still be in flight, and paid for twice when its answer arrives

mutations.name: SM5_the_dispatch_writer_checks_a_copy_of_the_rule
mutations.find:
self._apply_dispatch(_Draft(head_seq + 1, self.actor,
                                        att.request_id, now), payload,
                                 commit=False)
mutations.rationale: the defect the simulation found (D-2026-165): a second dispatch of one attempt is appended and the gateway's own replay refuses the history

mutations.name: SM6_the_settling_writer_checks_a_copy_of_the_rule
mutations.find:
self._apply_result(_Draft(head_seq + 1, self.actor,
                                      att.request_id, now), payload,
                               commit=False)
mutations.rationale: an outcome the protocol forbids for that attempt would be appended, and every later load refused

mutations.name: SM7_a_decided_hypothesis_flips_in_one_move
mutations.rationale: the latest observation, or an agent's assertion, would overturn a verdict instead of recording the disagreement

mutations.name: SM8_the_evaluation_ignores_resolution
mutations.find:
lo = got["value"] - got["resolution"]
        hi = got["value"] + got["resolution"]
mutations.rationale: a value whose resolution straddles the threshold would decide the hypothesis

mutations.name: SM9_disagreeing_observations_decide
mutations.rationale: whichever observation came out of the set first would decide

mutations.name: SM10_a_verdict_survives_its_observations
mutations.rationale: a hypothesis would stay SUPPORTED after every observation it was decided on went stale

mutations.name: SM11_the_status_writer_checks_a_copy_of_the_rule
mutations.rationale: an asserted verdict would be appended and every later load of the history refused

mutations.name: SM12_an_observation_of_a_result_without_standing
mutations.find: if sci is None or sci["state"] not in STANDING:
mutations.rationale: a result that lost its standing would still be observed

mutations.name: SM13_a_conclusion_on_an_undecided_hypothesis
mutations.rationale: an objective would be concluded on an open or inconclusive hypothesis

mutations.name: SM14_steps_past_the_limit
mutations.rationale: a controller would run past the steps its owner allowed

mutations.name: SM15_a_second_question_under_a_held_key_is_asked
mutations.rationale: D-2026-184: a second controller's own question for a step is granted under the step's key
